blocks.text: This Christmas, MEI MEI is knocking on your door. The eight-member girl group MEI MEI is celebrating the heart of Filipino Christmas with their newest single, “Namamasko Po!” – a playful and festive track that captures the warmth, generosity, and togetherness that make Paskong Pinoy truly special. Released under Groovy Garden Records, “Namamasko Po!” continues MEI MEI’s musical journey of celebrating Filipino culture through familiar experiences and distinctly Pinoy moments. Following their debut track “Telebong (Hello Po)” and the bold novelty-pop single “Alembong,” the group once again turns an everyday Filipino expression into a celebration of culture, community, and identity.
